scene.ko: 중간고사 성적이 떨어지고 수업 중에 휴대폰을 쓰는 아이에 대해 학부모에게 조심스럽게 이야기하고, 함께 도울 방법을 찾는다.

lines.en: Thank you for coming, Mr. Garcia. I wanted to talk with you about how Daniel's been doing lately.
lines.ko: 가르시아 씨, 와 주셔서 감사합니다. 요즘 대니얼이 어떻게 지내는지 말씀 나누고 싶었어요.
alt: Thanks for coming in, Mr. Garcia. I'd like to talk about how Daniel has been doing recently.

lines.en: First, I want you to know that Daniel is a kind boy, and his classmates really like him.
lines.ko: 우선 대니얼이 착한 아이이고, 반 친구들도 대니얼을 정말 좋아한다는 걸 말씀드리고 싶어요.
alt: Let me start by saying Daniel is a kind boy, and the other students really like him.

lines.en: That's nice to hear. But I have a feeling there's a 'but' coming.
lines.ko: 그 말을 들으니 좋네요. 그런데 왠지 '하지만'이 나올 것 같은데요.

lines.en: Well, I'm a little concerned about his midterm results. His math and science scores dropped quite a bit.
lines.ko: 네, 사실 중간고사 결과가 조금 걱정돼요. 수학이랑 과학 점수가 꽤 많이 떨어졌어요.
alt: I'm a bit worried about his midterm exams. His math and science scores went down quite a lot.

lines.en: I didn't know that. He told me the tests went fine.
I understand this might be hard to hear. I've also noticed that he's been using his phone in class, and he often looks tired in the morning.
lines.ko: 듣기 힘드실 수 있다는 거 이해해요. 수업 시간에 휴대폰을 쓰는 모습도 보였고, 아침에 피곤해 보일 때가 많아요.
alt: I know this isn't easy to hear. He's also been on his phone during class, and he often seems tired in the morning.

lines.en: He's been staying up late playing games. I've been working nights, so I haven't been able to check.
lines.ko: 요즘 밤늦게까지 게임을 해요. 제가 야간 근무를 하고 있어서 챙겨 보지 못했어요.

lines.en: Thank you for telling me. That really helps me understand. What if we work on this together? I can check in with him every week, and maybe you could set a time for phones off at home.
lines.ko: 말씀해 주셔서 감사해요. 이해하는 데 정말 도움이 돼요. 우리 같이 노력해 보면 어떨까요? 저는 매주 대니얼이랑 따로 이야기해 볼게요. 댁에서는 휴대폰을 끄는 시간을 정해 주시면 좋겠어요.
alt: Thanks for sharing that. It helps a lot. Why don't we work on this together? I'll talk with him every week, and maybe you could set a phone-free time at home.

lines.en: That sounds like a good plan. Thank you for caring about him so much.
lines.ko: 좋은 방법이네요. 아이를 이렇게 신경 써 주셔서 감사합니다.

expressions.en: I wanted to talk with you about ___.
First, I want you to know that ___.

expressions.note: 문제를 부드럽게 꺼낼 때 · worried 보다 차분함
